Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link an ADR for meaningful
contract, migration or architectural changes.

- [ ] Relevant tests, lint and frontend type/build checks passed; exclusions stated.
- [ ] Authorization, tenant boundaries, ownership and revocation preserved.
- [ ] New/changed API inputs reject unsupported fields; compatibility documented.
- [ ] Migrations append only; backup/upgrade/recovery tested where affected.
- [ ] Integration evidence labeled researched, simulated, protocol-tested or hardware-verified.
- [ ] No secrets, live device actions, deployment or unreviewed audit deletion.
- [ ] Reproduction/onboarding docs updated; residual risks identified.
